<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one signal appears in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10–30 ppm), at 26.40 ppm. The other upfield signals (36.40 ppm) are more consistent with methylene or tertiary carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
